items.title: Kirk Cousins: Stymied by 49ers again
items.text:
Cousins completed 26 of 38 passes for 235 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed once for no gain.

items.title: George Kittle: Two early TDs in Week 11 win
items.text:
Kittle caught all three of his targets for 34 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.

items.title: Brock Purdy: Tosses three TDs against elite defense
items.text:

items.title: Justin Jefferson: Seven catches in Week 11 loss

items.title: Mike Evans: Racks up 109 yards, TD in return
items.text:
